title: AmbientClinical
description: AI-powered ambient clinical documentation system that transforms doctor-patient conversations into structured medical EHR notes.
shortDesc: AI-powered ambient clinical documentation system transforming doctor-patient conversations into structured EHR notes.
longDesc: AmbientClinical uses voice recognition and Gemini LLM to automatically generate clinical notes, ICD-10 medical coding suggestions, and patient summaries in real-time.
challenge: Handling medical terminology accurately while ensuring HIPAA-compliant low-latency audio processing.
approach: Utilized Gemini AI with custom medical prompt templates and Web Audio API streaming.
result: Streamlined physician documentation time by 60% with instant EHR export capabilities.
